answer: Each submission hangs on the wharf of a task receipt, and the sonnet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
